faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Information Technology, Kalyani (IIIT Kalyani) for a research project sponsored by TCoE, DoT, Ministry of Communication.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in this notification?
faq.answer: The notification invites applications for Project Assistant (PA) and Intern positions under the research project.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies available for the Project Assistant and Intern positions combined under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for IIIT Kalyani Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 15th October 2026. Candidates must ensure applications reach the destination before this date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The mode of application is entirely through email. Candidates are required to send their scanned copies of documents and application forms to the designated email IDs.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Project Assistant and Intern positions will receive a consolidated monthly remuneration of up to Rs. 15,000 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the qualification required for Project Assistant?
faq.answer: Qualifications vary by post. It includes a Graduate degree in any stream with 50% marks, B.Tech in CSE/IT with 60% marks, or M.Sc in Mathematics with required marks.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified in the official notification for applying to these project-based temporary positions at IIIT Kalyani.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the application be emailed?
faq.answer: Applications should be emailed to [email protected] with a copy (CC) to [email protected] using the specified subject line.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I check the official website of IIIT Kalyani?
faq.answer: You can visit the official website of the institute at www.iiitkalyani.ac.in to access the complete recruitment advertisement and guidelines.
